scope: External TI SN74LS00 reference screening, not DL000 calibration

spice.decision: Rejected as default gate model: output remains high at a guaranteed TTL high input of 2 V. Model uses a half-supply switching threshold. Execution success does not establish device fidelity.

ibis.sourceScope: TI reports measurements using NS package; not DDR DL000 specimen measurements.
ibis.decision: Candidate for local output-current and pin-load sensitivity studies; not yet integrated.
ibis.distribution: Vendor files not committed; download from TI for local use. IBIS header restricts redistribution.

reproduce: Download and extract SDLM060, put SN74LS00.cir beside probe.cir and .spiceinit, then run ngspice -b probe.cir. Do not use -n: PSpice compatibility is required.
